_instructions: Template only. Do NOT put real secrets in this tracked file or commit a filled copy.
Copy this file to render-env.private.json on your own machine; that private file is git-ignored.
Fill secrets only in the private copy. Never paste tokens, passwords, or MongoDB URIs into chat.
The bulk sync process must target the 15 existing Render services by their verified service IDs and preserve unrelated variables.

Keep each worker's database/cluster mapping explicit. Do not share one URI across workers unless the isolation design explicitly permits it.
